License and notice files shipped inside the published crate packages for the crates in the LINKED dependency closure of
deltachat-rpc-server 2.69.0 (git commit 189c007b9a343eb4639892fc3defafbf9f367da3) for target aarch64-linux-android, default features
(which include `vendored`: bundled SQLCipher and OpenSSL 3.4.1 via openssl-src).
How it was computed: `cargo tree -p deltachat-rpc-server --target aarch64-linux-android -e normal --locked --prefix none` (cargo 1.100.0, the
lockfile of the tag). This is cargo's normal-dependency tree for that target, minus proc-macro crates (compile-time only, not linked),
plus openssl-src (a build dependency whose bundled C sources are compiled into the binary). Build recipe owner: chatmail/core
nix/android-package.nix and .github/workflows/deltachat-rpc-server.yml (`nix build .#deltachat-rpc-server-arm64-v8a-android`, NDK 27.2.12479018).
Not checked: that each listed crate's code is actually present in the shipped PyPI wheel binary (I did not build it); platform runtime
notices of the NDK (not fetched). Each text appears once with the crates that ship it.
